description: What we do At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide. We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good. Application requirement: Intro video As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering: Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you. Upload your video using thisform(YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;) Your role As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals. This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket. You will: Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement. Design and build scalable backend systems, including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products. Build and ship applied AI/LLM features, such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation. Improve the robustness of our systems, strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale. Work directly with users, product, and data, using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works. Prototype and test new AI capabilities, turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap. Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge, helping the team make better product and technical decisions. Collaborate closely with other engineers, including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving. Your profile Technical requirements Strong professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems. Experience in a small, high-ownership product team, ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers. Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end, rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation. Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly). Strong API, database, and systems design skills, with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products. Applied AI/LLM experience: you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems. A solid software-quality mindset, including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security. Cloud and container experience, with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads. Fluent English (C1+), both written and spoken. Nice to have Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems. Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads. Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting. German language skills. Who you are Kind and collaborative: You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment. Mission-driven: You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action. Sharp and curious: You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems. A product-minded builder: You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value. Highly self-directed: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight. Pragmatic and action-oriented: You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements. Opinionated but open-minded: You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others. Commercially aware and creative: You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed. If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection! What we offer Competitive salary and equity, reflecting your impact and ownership. Purpose-driven mission: Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent. Flexible hybrid setup: Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus. Trust and autonomy: Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows. A genuinely high-impact role: Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation. Dynamic environment: Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability. Learning budget and quarterly hackathons: Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward. Within the Face team, we develop systems for face verification, uniqueness and duplicate detection, presentation attack detection, and supporting capabilities such as face detection, image quality assessment, occlusion detection, pose estimation, and others that allow these systems to operate reliably in real-world conditions. An "in-the-driver's-seat" operating style: you take ownership of problems end-to-end, drive your work forward without waiting for direction, and stand behind your decisions once they are in production. title: IT Support Specialist (m/w/d)
description: Du hast Freude daran, technische Probleme zu lösen, behältst auch bei mehreren offenen Themen den Überblick und kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich erklären? Dabei geht es bei uns nicht um klassischen Callcenter-Support, sondern darum, Probleme wirklich zu verstehen, strukturiert einzugrenzen und gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Teams Lösungen zu finden. Warum brauchen wir diese Rolle? Mit unseren Produkten, Kunden und Anwendungsfällen wächst auch die Zahl der Themen, die im täglichen Betrieb schnell und zuverlässig gelöst werden müssen. Deshalb möchten wir unseren Support weiter professionalisieren und suchen jemanden, der Supportfälle strukturiert übernimmt, technische Zusammenhänge analysiert und dafür sorgt, dass unsere Kund:innen schnell die richtige Unterstützung bekommen. Gleichzeitig bist du eine wichtige Schnittstelle zu unseren technischen und fachlichen Teams: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Fehlerbilder, bereitest komplexere Fälle sauber auf und hilfst damit auch uns, unsere Produkte und Prozesse kontinuierlich besser zu machen. Warum ist die Rolle spannend? Du bearbeitest bei uns nicht einfach Tickets nach Schema F. Unsere Lösungen bewegen sich in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld und verbinden Software, unterschiedliche Systeme, Schnittstellen und Prozesse im Gesundheitswesen miteinander. Das bedeutet: Hinter einer Supportanfrage steckt manchmal eine einfache Bedienfrage – manchmal aber auch ein technisches Puzzle. Du lernst unsere Produkte und Systeme sehr genau kennen, arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Deployment und Fachbereichen zusammen und entwickelst mit der Zeit ein gutes Gespür dafür, wo ein Problem entsteht und wie wir es am besten lösen können. Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wichtig ist uns vor allem, dass du gerne Probleme löst, strukturiert arbeitest und Freude an der Kommunikation mit Menschen hast. Erfahrung im IT-Support, Service Desk oder technischen Kundensupport ist von Vorteil Gutes technisches Verständnis sowie eine strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen sowie im Umgang mit Fehlermeldungen und Logs Hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie eine klare, freundliche und verbindliche Kommunikation Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Kenntnisse im IT-Service-Management, zum Beispiel nach ITIL v4, sind wünschenswert Grundkenntnisse in Webanwendungen, APIs und JSON sind von Vorteil Kenntnisse im Apotheken-, Pharma- oder Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung Uns ist wichtiger, wie du an Probleme herangehst, wie du kommunizierst und ob du Lust hast, dich in unsere Produkte und Technologien einzuarbeiten, als dass du bereits jedes Kästchen erfüllst. Auch der sinnvolle Einsatz von KI im Arbeitsalltag wird bei uns ausdrücklich gefördert und ist bereits Teil unserer Arbeitsweise. Über eHealth-Connect Wir entwickeln Software und digitale Lösungen für eine moderne, vernetzte Gesundheitsversorgung. Unsere Technologien verbinden unterschiedliche Akteure und Systeme im Gesundheitswesen und tragen dazu bei, digitale Versorgung einfacher, sicherer und besser nutzbar zu machen. Dabei arbeiten wir an der Schnittstelle zwischen moderner Softwareentwicklung, Telematikinfrastruktur und neuen digitalen Versorgungskonzepten. Wir arbeiten hybrid und haben ein modernes Büro in Berlin-Mitte, das wir als Ort für Zusammenarbeit, Austausch und gemeinsame Teamtage nutzen. Klingt nach etwas, das zu dir passen könnte? Dann melde dich bei uns. Ob mit Lebenslauf oder einfach ein paar Sätzen darüber, wer du bist, was du bisher gemacht hast und warum dich die Rolle interessiert – wir möchten vor allem dich kennenlernen. The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast. What You’ll Do Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going An Ideal Candidate Should Have Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required) Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it created A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended, what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual request — rather than against a summary of it Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it A preference for being corrected over being right Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes Interview process Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
description: YOU & AHEAD At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe. We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch. As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands. Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! YOUR TASKS End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions. Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed. Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production. Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start. Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving. Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows. YOUR PROFILE You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory. You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations. You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements. You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially. You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English. WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets. Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products. Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management. Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing. Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand. Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe. AND WHY AHEAD? Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together. Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more) Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve) Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget This role is based in Hamburg, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week and the option to work from abroad for agreed upon periods. If this resonates with you, we're excited to go ahead with you! title: Backend Engineer - Data (m/f/d)
description: Berlin Mitte · Hybrid (up to 2 days/week remote) · €60,000–75,000 + VSOP equity Help us decarbonize cement and concrete - not tomorrow, today alcemy is on a mission to keep 100 million tons of CO₂ out of the atmosphere every year by 2030. Making concrete accounts for around 8% of global CO₂ emissions, and our machine-learning software runs inside cement and concrete plants 24/7 to cut it - without sacrificing quality or driving up costs. We're already live in a third of Germany's cement plants and 30+ ready-mix concrete plants. The role You'll own the systems that get plant data into alcemy. That data comes from external partners, and it arrives messy. You'll build and own the APIs and services that take it in, make sense of it, and feed the machine-learning models behind our recommendations - designing those systems, deploying them, keeping them running, and diagnosing what went wrong when something upstream changes without warning. It's a backend engineering role with a data problem at the centre of it, and it's refreshingly hands-on with customers: you'll dig into real-world data, explain what you find to non-technical people, and make getting data into alcemy dramatically easier. What you need is solid production Python, the ability to run what you build, and comfort talking to the people on the other end of the pipe. What you'll do Own the data ingestion systems that bring messy plant data from external partners into something our ML can use Build and improve our ingestion APIs, moving us from strict, structured data requirements toward flexible, AI-powered ingestion — so customers onboard with far less friction Deploy, monitor and troubleshoot your systems in production, diagnosing and fixing issues when something upstream changes without warning Track down data anomalies and explain your findings to customers in plain language Build and maintain the APIs and PostgreSQL databases behind our products, and keep production running smoothly Work shoulder to shoulder with external partners, customers, sales and customer success - translating between the technical and the non-technical Collaborate with the product team on backend work Requirements You'll thrive here if... above all, you care about climate change and want your work to count. Must-haves You've deployed production-grade Python applications You know how to deploy, monitor and troubleshoot production systems in a cloud environment You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you collaborate well across roles You're comfortable working directly with customers, sales and customer success - patient, plain-spoken, and at ease with non-technical enterprise teams You pick up unfamiliar codebases quickly, and you're keen to contribute early You're open to using AI tools to augment how you work Nice-to-haves Exposure to machine learning or data pipeline projects Experience with FastAPI, Flask or Django PostgreSQL or similar SQL databases Experience designing or maintaining integrations with third-party or partner systems Don't tick every box? We'd still love to hear from you. How we work You won't be working alone - you'll build collaboratively alongside senior and junior engineers, owning features end to end: build, test, review, deploy. Small team, direct customer exposure, fast startup pace - so async communication, clear prioritisation, transparency, and direct feedback are the norm, and how we work is something we shape together, and keep improving. We use Claude Code responsibly: AI to move fast, engineers always in charge and accountable, no AI-slop merge requests. We'll ask you to be flexible. We don't have fixed teams or fixed projects here. As the business shifts, we'll ask you to move to where the work matters most and pick up new problems. If you enjoy variety and switching between problems, you'll do well here. Hybrid by design (Berlin Mitte office, up to 2 days remote, plus offsites and boat trips), with real room to grow along technical-expert or management tracks - and the chance to lead a product area within a couple of years. Benefits 25 days' vacation - plus an extra day for every 2 years here, and the days between Christmas and New Year off €1,500/year and 3 days/quarter for your own development The Mac of your choice An office in the heart of Berlin Mitte Our Tech Stack Backend & data: Python throughout - FastAPI (auto-generated Swagger/OpenAPI), SQLAlchemy, pydantic, pytest, mypy; pandas, polars, numpy, sklearn; uv for dependencies Infra: PostgreSQL, AWS on Kubernetes managed with Terraform, ArgoWorkflows for scheduled jobs, GitLab for code Frontend: React & Next.js in TypeScript with TailwindCSS; Blueprint.js / Radix UI; TanStack Query or axios; Streamlit for internal tools Our Hiring Process is fully remote Intro call with our Recruiter Meet our Hiring Manager A take-home task that mirrors the real work you'd be doing Technical interview (90 min) with two engineers, including 30 min of live coding Team-fit interview (45 min) with two future teammates At alcemy, we're building a team as diverse as the industry we're transforming. We welcome applications from everyone and assess every candidate on merit alone - regardless of gender, age, ethnic or national origin, religion or worldview, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We especially encourage people who are underrepresented in tech to apply. If you need any adjustments to take part fully in our hiring process, just let us know and we'll make them. Note: We don't currently offer visa sponsorship, so you'll need a valid EU work visa. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Search Backend Engineer (m/f/x)
description: About commercetools Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people. Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers.The kind of people who not only pioneered a more flexible approach to commerce architecture but also shaped the culture of experimentation that approach unlocked. Together, they are the engine of commerce innovation today. At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits. Here, the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce but to build your own. Your Impact As a Senior Search Engineer on our Discovery Team, you will build the retrieval layer behind product discovery for some of the world’s most demanding commerce brands. Search is changing shape. Shoppers type full sentences instead of keywords, and increasingly the client calling our API is an AI agent rather than a person. We are on the path to take our semantic and hybrid retrieval to general availability, and tackling the hard problems: making it fast, affordable, measurably better across enterprise catalogs, and working out what comes after it. You would join that work at every layer, from query understanding down to the vector index and the cost of a single query. You will: Design and implement search functionalities in a PaaS ecommerce Scala backend Develop search capabilities that combine lexical, semantic, and hybrid retrieval Develop search-related libraries based on ElasticSearch and MongoDB Contribute to search relevance and quality, and to how we measure it Run and maintain a scalable search “infrastructure as code” on top of Kubernetes using terraform and multi-tenant architecture Test software components regarding usability, functionality, and performance, and work closely with Product Management and DevOps Learn Scala and functional programming as your new main development tools Take part in on-call rotation with a worldwide distributed team for production systems This role is hybrid, with three days a week spent in our Munich, Berlin, London or Valencia office. What Sets You Apart You're a creative problem-solver who is wired to find solutions. You confidently dive into complex challenges and have a talent for making them simple for others. Your curiosity drives you to constantly grow and contribute to an environment of trust and teamwork. Great ideas come from many paths, and your unique perspective matters more than checking every box. What matters most is the mindset you bring to the work. You do not need to be an ML researcher for this role. You need to be a strong backend engineer who is genuinely interested in retrieval quality. You bring: At least 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer, with production experience on the JVM Solid understanding of parallel and asynchronous programming, as well as non-blocking I/O Experience developing REST APIs and knowledge of scalable architectures, including sharding, replication, load balancing, and failover Interest in working with Scala using pragmatic functional programming patterns. If you come from another JVM language, we will support you in picking it up. Fluent English for work in international teams Experience operating multi-tenant SaaS where one tenant’s load must never affect another’s Knowledge of scalable event-driven architectures, including queues and notification topics A genuine curiosity for using AI tools to work smarter and more effectively, paired with a drive to learn and put them into practice in your role. Nice to Have: Hands-on search experience, preferably ElasticSearch or OpenSearch, including a working understanding of how an inverted index scores and ranks documents Practical exposure to vector retrieval, such as embeddings, approximate nearest neighbor indexes, and hybrid ranking, and a sense of where each approach breaks down. A deep lexical search background plus a clear appetite to go into this territory also works. Comfort reasoning about relevance with data, including precision and recall tradeoffs, ranking metrics, and behavioral signals Experience with infrastructure work and other technologies like Helm, Kubernetes, and Rust Our Benefits Because work and life are connected, our benefits are too. We’ve designed them to give you the security, flexibility, and opportunities you need to focus on what matters most. 🩺 Comprehensive health benefits for you and your dependents, including access to OpenUp for personalized mental health support 📚 Learning and development opportunities including an annual learning budget, access to self-paced learning platforms and language training, personalized coaching, mentorship, and leadership programs 🍼 Family Leave Plus gives you additional fully paid weeks of parental leave on top of government-provided leave, so you can spend more time with your new addition 📈 Our equity participation program allows you to share in our success For more information on our benefits, visit this page. Come as you are. Build with us. Your unique perspective is essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the world around us because we know it’s the only way to build the future. We celebrate our differences and have created a hiring process that’s fair, inclusive, and designed to let your talent shine. We proudly welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, and any other part of your identity that makes you who you are. As an equal opportunity employer, we believe that our strength lies in our diversity, and we invite you to be a part of our global community. For more information on our diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging practices, visit this page. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role: As a (Senior) Software Engineer, Robot Control at TACTILIA Robotics, you will help design and build the software that turns our robotic hardware into a reliable, scalable product. You will work across embedded, control, and application software, taking ownership of complex technical problems and helping shape the architecture as the platform evolves. You will work closely with the CTO and engineering team, with the autonomy to make important technical decisions and see them through to working systems. This is a hands-on role. You will move between architecture, implementation, and the lab, solving the challenges that arise when software meets real hardware What you will do: Set the architecture. Embedded, control, and application layers — modular and reusable across product variants, not a one-off for a single prototype. Write the control loops that can't miss a beat. Deterministic firmware on the embedded target: hardware abstraction, sensor/actuator integration, fault handling, hard real-time constraints. No room for "usually works." Turn commands into grasps. Position, torque, force impedance and admittance control, coordinated multi-finger motion, and handle all different states to make the grasp stable and reliable Build the simulation before hardware pays the price Simulation models for control development, regression testing, and sim-to-real validation — most iteration should happen before anyone touches a real hand. Ship SDKs people actually want to integrate. ROS 2, fieldbuses, and customer-facing interfaces — documented and version-stable, not tribal knowledge. Make the sensor data mean something. Build the pipeline for tactile, position, and force data; build models for slip detection and contact-state estimation; turn field telemetry into the next product iteration. Get ahead of the Cyber Resilience Act. Security by design, SBOM, vulnerability handling, a real update path — well before the December 2027 deadline, including the technical documentation for conformity assessment. Build tooling like it's product, not plumbing. CI/CD, automated and simulation-based regression tests, logging and diagnostics you'd actually want to debug with at 2am. Work across the whole team. Tight loop with Electronics, Mechanics, and Application —spec input, customer integration support, the works. What you bring: A degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field. 5–10 years building embedded, robotics, or control software, ideally including at least one product that reached series production or product maturity Strong modern C++ and Python with a deep understanding of real-time behaviour, concurrency, memory and resource constraints Solid hands-on experience with robot control: closed-loop control, state estimation, filtering, motion coordination, force/impedance control, or related areas. You have architected software for a product, not a prototype someone else productionized later Simulation-based development (Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo, or similar) Comfortable with Linux, Git, CI/CD, automated testing A strong hardware mindset: you enjoy bringing up systems, debugging on real robots, and getting to the bottom of problems with a scope, logic analyzer, debugger, or whatever tool gets the job done Fluent English; German is a plus, not a requirement Bonus: Dexterous manipulation, grasp planning, or robotic hands Tactile sensing and contact-rich manipulation Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
description: YOUR MISSION A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest. We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers, with real revenue and customers who tell us when we are slow. The problems are open ones. Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. There is research to borrow from and very little product to copy. Senior or staff level depending on experience. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON You will own large problems end to end, across the stack. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but here is what the last two years have actually involved. A multi-agent orchestration SDK, built from scratch. Nothing off the shelf handled what we needed: long-horizon execution that runs for hours and survives restarts. CAD conversion as a real pipeline. It used to be manual and brittle. Turning it into production infrastructure meant writing a Python wrapper around a C++ SDK and making it reliable enough to sit under everything else. Migrating the application off Electron and Webpack onto SSR React with Vite. That architecture is what the whole product now sits on. What is coming: 3D-to-3D search across real customer part libraries, not benchmark datasets Constraint solvers and optimization, and getting an agent to use one sensibly Agents that hold a useful model of a physical object, which is still an open problem Hybrid cloud deployments for manufacturers who cannot send their data anywhere We work in Python and TypeScript, with multi-agent orchestration and AI integrations across several providers. WHAT WE CARE ABOUT You have shipped production systems across frontend and backend, and can point at them Your CV reads as a set of problems, not a stack You use AI heavily to go faster, but you built things the hard way first You are fine when the problem is not yet defined You deliver end to end, and you are still there when it needs maintaining Bonus: CAD, computational geometry, constraint solving or optimization, 3D, LLM agents, industrial software. None required. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Backend Developer (Rust)
description: Rust Engineer — Distributed Execution Engine Berlin (hybrid) or Remote (countries within ~4–5 hours travel of Berlin) About our client Our client is a B2B sourcing platform serving the automotive dealership industry. They're a small, fast-moving engineering team building core infrastructure from the ground up rather than assembling off-the-shelf tools — the kind of environment where a single engineer's technical decisions shape the product for years. About the role You'll join a small engineering team building the client's sourcing platform. Your focus will be their flowgraph — a horizontally scalable, step-based execution engine, similar in spirit to n8n or Unreal Engine's Blueprints, but built from the ground up in Rust with strong typing and production workloads in mind. It drives their order processing and ETL pipelines. This isn't a typical backend role. Rather than wiring together managed queues and off-the-shelf orchestration tools, the team builds its own coordination and fault-tolerance mechanisms from scratch — because the workloads don't fit neatly into existing solutions. If you enjoy thinking about graph theory, type systems, parsers and compilers, WASM runtimes, or distributed systems architecture as part of your everyday work — not just as a personal interest — you'll feel at home here. What you'll do Research, design, and build on the client's bespoke distributed graph execution engine, written in Rust. Design and implement graph executor node implementations to power third-party integrations with partner and supplier systems. Build and maintain infrastructure for the distributed execution engine — deployment pipelines, observability, and site reliability. Design and implement coordination and fault-tolerance mechanisms from scratch (not by wrapping existing message queues) — handling partial failures, node coordination, and recovery within the engine itself. Develop and maintain logistics and ETL workflows within this ecosystem, tied directly to the core business. What we're looking for Must-have: 7+ years of backend development experience. 3+ years of professional Rust experience. Strong, practical grasp of distributed systems and fault-tolerant software architecture. Familiarity with at least some of: graph theory, type theory, parsers and compilers, and related CS fundamentals. We don't expect mastery of all of these — most strong candidates bring deep expertise in 3–4 out of 5 core areas, with distributed systems being the one we weight most heavily. Real-world DevOps experience. Nice to have: A background in C/C++ before moving to Rust. Experience with key-value stores or distributed databases — FoundationDB or TiKV are a big plus. Experience with frontend web development. Experience with existing low-/no-code workflow tools (n8n, Prefect, AWS Step Functions). Understanding of WASM runtimes. Previous experience with logistics or process management systems. Location & setup Berlin / Wildau area: hybrid, with 1 day per week in the office. Elsewhere within ~4–5 hours' travel of Berlin: fully remote, no office requirement. Employment: official employment in Germany, or B2B contract elsewhere in Europe. Full-time, ~40 hours/week, with meaningful overlap with CEST hours. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
description: The problem The construction industry loses $1.6 trillion a year to inefficiency, and most of it is avoidable. The knowledge that would prevent it already exists. We're building the opposite of that: software for the people who run large, complex construction projects. It reads the documents, tracks the decisions, and catches the mistakes early. The model isn't the moat. The project memory is, and it compounds: every project makes the system better, and a competitor starting today is already years of projects behind. Our software runs today on a live autobahn construction program and an S-Bahn transit program: multi-year timelines, hundreds of thousands of pages of specs, protocols, and site communications, and real consequences when we get an answer wrong. We're pre-seed, led by Realyze Ventures, whose LPs include Zech and other large European construction groups. Co-investors: D11Z, the family office behind Aleph Alpha, and the CDTM Venture Fund, backed by 300+ CDTM alumni including the founders of Personio and Alasco and DeepMind's Technical Director. 25+ live customers. Tasks What you'd work on Two hard problems, both in production. AI-native project management, not a chatbot on PDFs. You build the product project managers live in every day: the dashboards, task views, and alerts. The AI belongs in the background, not in a sidebar you talk to, so you're building surfaces where automation runs on cronjobs, recommendations surface for the PM to approve, and some tasks run end to end with the user only reviewing after. The data layer under a five-year project. Construction data is deeply interconnected: documents, protocols, decisions, tasks, and stakeholders all cross-reference each other across timelines that run for years.
